arguments.value: William D. Quarles, Jr., born in Baltimore, Maryland in 1948, served as a judge of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland from 2003 to 2016. He earned an A.A. from Community College of Baltimore, a B.S. from the University of Maryland, and a J.D. from the Catholic University of America, Columbus School of Law. Earlier in his career, he clerked for Judge Joseph C. Howard of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland, practiced privately, served as an assistant U.S. attorney for the District of Maryland, returned to private practice in Baltimore, and later served as an associate judge on the Maryland Circuit Court in Baltimore City.
